_comment: Accelerator pedal sensor supply - STP 8.3.3.3: two channels. (1) measure the supply voltage after the key-switch falling edge and before ECM power-down; (2) measure the delay from the CH1 falling edge (key switch) to the CH2 falling edge (accel pedal sensor supply). CH1 5 V/div at 0 div (use 10 V/div for 24 V ECM calibrations), CH2 2 V/div at -3.5 div, both DC. 2.0 s/div, edge trigger on CH1 FALLING at half of battery voltage, NORMal (single-shot) mode. Plain numbers in the scope's native units: vertical_scale in V/div, vertical_position in divisions, trigger_position in %, record_length in points, trigger_level "half_battery" = half of battery_voltage. The capture window is NOT stored in the config; set it per call with configure_scope(..., duration_s=SECONDS), which sets s/div = duration_s/10. WINDOW: pass duration_s=20 to configure_scope for this test (20 s total = 2 s/div x 10).
name: accel_pedal_sensor
